*F-KE* (Key exchange, authenticated KE) is part of *Layer 3: Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Canetti and Krawczyk. *Analysis of key-exchange protocols and their use for building secure channels*. In Advances in Cryptology – EUROCRYPT 2001, volume 2045 of LNCS, pages 453–474, 2001.
- Bellare and Rogaway. *Entity authentication and key distribution*. In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 1993, volume 773 of LNCS, pages 232–249, 1994.
